versions.changelog:
Initial release of Obstetrics-and-Gynecology-PMPH-10edition skill, featuring 187 clinical skills from the PMPH 10th edition textbook.

- Covers 15 major categories including pregnancy management, gynecologic oncology, infertility, infections, and more.
- Each skill entry includes identifier, Chinese display name, category, trigger criteria, and reference path.
- Structured for clinical use, aligned with scenarios as found in the PMPH 10th edition.
- Comprehensive registry enables easy access and integration for teaching or clinical settings.
